text:
Marie (Docs): heads up — I opened a docs PR for the model-catalog changelog + migration notes for the 'twin-3' deprecation. need review/merge gating. 1793456789
Josh (Eng): link? PR number?
Marie (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 : includes migration guide snippet and SDK examples for the new quantized variant.
Anita (PM): timeline: we want this in the public changelog for next Tuesday's publish. can we have it merged by Mon EOD? :calendar:
Sam (ENG-Runtime): I can review the migration steps around kv-cache differences. will check today.
Eve (Docs): quick note — the docs-preview CI failed the linkchecker for one internal link (examples/sdk/js/old-call.md -> 404). added a fix in the PR but preview still shows error.
ci-bot: docs-preview/build #291 failed: link-checker 1 error (examples/sdk/js/old-call.md -> 404). See logs: https://ci.internal/reports/291
Marie (Docs): thanks, Eve. I replaced the old-call reference with the new js-snippet path. but CI still flags `api-models.md` anchor that changed after the catalog edits.
Josh (Eng): anchor got renamed when we moved the model catalog sections. easiest fix is to add a redirect anchor in api-models.md: `<!-- redirect: twin-3 -->` or update link to the new `#model-variants` anchor.
Paul (Product): are we also calling out customer migration steps in the changelog? need to avoid surprise.
Marie (Docs): yes — PR includes a short migration checklist and a 'breaking changes' callout. excerpt: "If you rely on twin-3 small, switch to twin-3-quant or twin-3-ft; update your model_id and rehydrate KV cache on first run."
Anita (PM): ok add a note about storage format change for KV cache — call out a one-time warmup recommendation.
Sam (ENG-Runtime): confirmed — kv cache binary layout differs in the quantized path. recommend `--warmup-requests 50` for large sessions. can add that to the migration snippet.
Eve (Docs): I pushed a tiny commit with `--warmup-requests 50` and the anchor redirect. still waiting on CI.
ci-bot: docs-preview/build #292 queued.
Lucas (Release): merge window today is 18:00 PST. we need 2 approvers + green docs-preview before that to include in the release notes.
Josh (Eng): i'll give a full pass by 16:30 PST and add comments. can we get one more reviewer from product? Paul?
Paul (Product): will review by 17:00 PST.
Marie (Docs): tagging @here for reviewers: @Josh (Eng), @Paul (Product), @Sam (ENG-Runtime). please add approvals or request changes ASAP.
Josh (Eng): small nit on the JS SDK snippet — the async iterator example can be simplified. propose:
```js
for await (const chunk of client.generate({ model: 'twin-3-quant', input: prompt })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk);
}
```
will update in a follow-up commit if that's ok.
Eve (Docs): saw that — please push the simplified snippet, it's easier to copy. :+1:
ci-bot: docs-preview/build #292 failed: markdown-lint 2 warnings, link-checker still 1 error (api-models.md#model-variants -> 404).
Sam (ENG-Runtime): hmm I can reproduce locally — the anchor is `#model-variants-overview` now. Eve, can you change the link to that exact anchor?
Eve (Docs): on it. pushing change.
ci-bot: docs-preview/build #293 started.
Marie (Docs): if #293 passes, is everyone comfortable with a squash-merge? We want a clean changelog commit history.
Josh (Eng): squash is fine. just ensure commit message includes the migration checklist.
Paul (Product): agree. include a short blurb for the customer-facing changelog: "Deprecated twin-3; migration pathways and recommended quantized variants included."
Lucas (Release): +1. once CI is green and we have two approvals we can merge at 18:00 PST.
deploy-bot: reminder — weekly docs deploy at 19:00 PST. merging before 18:00 will get included in today's rollout.
ci-bot: docs-preview/build #293 succeeded. link-checker OK. markdown-lint 0 warnings.
Josh (Eng): LGTM :shipit:
Paul (Product): Approved :white_check_mark:
Marie (Docs): thanks! merging now. will squash and include release-note blurb.
Marie (Docs): Merge complete — PR #4823 merged at 1793456825. tagging release team for notes.
Lucas (Release): got it, adding the changelog entry to today's release notes section under 'Model catalog updates'.
Anita (PM): perfect — thanks everyone. follow-up: can we add a short automated test to catch anchor renames in future?
Sam (ENG-Runtime): yes — I'll open a tiny CI job that runs the linkchecker against the model-catalog build output every PR.
Marie (Docs): created follow-up ticket: https://go/redwood/tickets/2129 — will track the CI job and add a test template for docs authors.
Eve (Docs): celebratory :tada: nice teamwork!
Paul (Product): :champagne:
Marie (Docs): closing thread.
